diff --git a/fastapi/params.py b/fastapi/params.py
index 6a58d580..c4a0cb0f 100644
--- a/fastapi/params.py
+++ b/fastapi/params.py
@@ -768,7 +768,42 @@ class Depends:
     use_cache: bool = True
     scope: Union[Literal["function", "request"], None] = None
 
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        return hash((self.dependency, self.use_cache, self.scope))
+
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        if not isinstance(other, Depends):
+            return NotImplemented
+        return (
+            self.dependency == other.dependency
+            and self.use_cache == other.use_cache
+            and self.scope == other.scope
+        )
+
 
 @dataclass
 class Security(Depends):
     scopes: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None
+
+    def __hash__(self) -> int:
+        # Convert scopes to a hashable type (tuple)
+        hashable_scopes = tuple(self.scopes) if self.scopes is not None else None
+        return hash((self.dependency, self.use_cache, self.scope, hashable_scopes))
+
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        if not isinstance(other, Security):
+            return NotImplemented
+        # Compare scopes as sequences (order matters)
+        return (
+            self.dependency == other.dependency
+            and self.use_cache == other.use_cache
+            and self.scope == other.scope
+            and (
+                (self.scopes is None and other.scopes is None)
+                or (
+                    self.scopes is not None
+                    and other.scopes is not None
+                    and tuple(self.scopes) == tuple(other.scopes)
+                )
+            )
+        )
